component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.signature.schema
component.documentation: The add-on's schemas and facets. A kit's record type that can be sent for signature carries the Signable facet, which brings the signable schema, prefix sgn, written by the server only; the type must be versionable, since the signed file is filed as a new version. A kit's signature request type carries the SignatureRequest facet, which brings the signature_request schema, prefix sigreq.
